scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I am collecting stories to make a song on behalf of Aigu.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我正在收集故事，好替艾古寫歌。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Hi. I'm the new member of the Dandelion band Ragi. I am making songs on behalf of Aigu. Are you interested in a story?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
你好，我是蒲公英樂隊的新成員拉吉，正在替艾古創作歌曲。想聽聽故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Only adventurers from Eden Group are welcome here.
I'm giving requests to base level ^FF0000130-140^000000 adventurers only.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
這裡只接待樂園團成員。
我只向基礎等級^FF0000130～140^000000的冒險者釋出委託。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Haha. I am sorry to request to adventurers even though I am a new.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
哈哈，雖然我剛加入樂隊，也得麻煩各位冒險者幫忙，真不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Just take a look at the list. Can you help me if it is okay with you?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
先看看這份清單吧。如果你願意，可以幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Request to collect stories
scripts.translation: 收集故事的委託

scripts.text: Conversation
scripts.translation: 聊天

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I will continue to make a story or songs. But adventurers should step into a new adventure.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我會繼續寫故事、作歌曲。不過冒險者還得踏上新的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
This song and story is about monsters. ^FF0000Tell me the story about how you felt while you were fighting with them.^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
這首歌講的是魔物的故事。^FF0000請告訴我與它們戰鬥時的感受。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
This is the request of Aigu but it is dangerous. You should grow up more.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
這是艾古託付的委託，不過很危險。你還得繼續歷練才行。

scripts.text: The story of the lost
scripts.translation: 失落者的故事

scripts.text: Story of devil
scripts.translation: 惡魔的故事

scripts.text: Story from far away distance
scripts.translation: 遠方的故事

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Lighthalzen has many stories that I'm sure are sad and lost. Their stories should not be forgotten so please tell me what you can.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
裡希塔樂鎮裡有許多悲傷而失落的故事，不該被人遺忘。請把你知道的都告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Do you know the story about Satan Morocc? I want to sing a song of their story even when time passes by.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
你聽過魔王夢羅克的故事嗎？我想把這個故事寫成歌，讓它流傳下去。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I never been to Ash Vacuum but I heard there are many interesting creatures there in the Scaraba Hall.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我沒去過異世界，不過聽說聖甲蟲大廳裡有許多有趣的魔物。

scripts.text: Egnigem Cenia (Swordman Monster)
scripts.translation: 暗●劍士（劍士型魔物）

scripts.text: Armeyer Dinze (Merchant Monster)
scripts.translation: 暗●商人（商人型魔物）

scripts.text: Wickebine Tres (Thief Monster)
scripts.translation: 暗●盜賊（盜賊型魔物）

scripts.text: Kavach Icarus (Archer Monster)
scripts.translation: 暗●弓箭手（弓箭手型魔物）

scripts.text: Errende Ebecee (Acolyte Monster)
scripts.translation: 暗●服事（服事型魔物）

scripts.text: Laurell Weinder (Mage Monster)
scripts.translation: 暗●魔法師（魔法師型魔物）

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Some adventurers tell me stories a little bit but they are not enough to make a song out of.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
有些冒險者會告訴我一點故事，但這些還不足以譜成一首歌。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
She is a sad swordman in such a far away place. What brought here there do you think?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
遠方有個悲傷的女劍士。你覺得是什麼讓她來到那裡？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
How far could she have continued her journey? I guess she could not do it alone.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
她的旅程究竟走了多遠？我想她一定不是獨自前行。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
What might have moved her mind? She only cared about money.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
究竟是什麼觸動了她？她以前眼裡只有錢。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Yes. It seems that I have heard the same name from Payon. I am not sure it means the same.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
是啊，我好像也在斐揚聽過這個名字。不過不確定說的是不是同一個人。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
No matter if it was for friendship or a mission. If that journey was for someone, It would not be easy to stop the journey.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
無論是為了友誼還是為了任務，只要旅程是為了某個人，就很難輕易停下。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
By the way. I have read a book called ^FF0000How to be a wizard^000000...
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
對了，我讀過一本叫^FF0000《如何成為巫師》^000000的書......

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
A sword woman who is stronger than any swordmen. Egnigem Cenia. That is her name. I am not sure if that is her or someone else.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
有個比所有劍士都強的女劍士，名叫暗●劍士——艾格尼格姆·塞妮婭。我也不確定那是不是她本人。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
A daughter of a merchant. Armeyer Dinze, she looks like a rich woman. But she looks insecure.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
暗●商人阿爾梅爾·丁澤是商人的女兒，看起來家境富裕，卻似乎心事重重。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Nobody knows how it has started. Wickebine Tres is the name who could have found a true companion.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
沒人知道故事從何開始。暗●盜賊維克貝恩·特雷斯或許找到了真正的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Kavach Icarus is the name whose hands are faster than eyes and shoots arrows swiftly.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
暗●弓箭手卡瓦奇·伊卡魯斯出手快如閃電，箭矢總能迅速命中目標。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Errende Ebecee is the one who started a journey to look for someone.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
暗●服事艾倫德·艾貝西踏上旅程，是為了尋找某個人。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Laurell Weinder, who decided to have a difficult journey to repay gratitude for some wizards deed.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
暗●魔法師勞雷爾·溫德爾為了報答一位巫師的恩情，決定踏上艱難的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Have you heard any new stories? Please tell me stories if you have any from your journey.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
旅途中聽到什麼新鮮事了嗎？有故事的話就講給我聽吧。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
These are very important stories to someone. I want to make a song with these stories. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
這些故事對某個人來說非常重要。我想把它們寫成歌，請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I can not lose her story. I really wish you to stop by.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我不想讓她的故事就這樣消失，真心希望你能順道幫忙。

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
It will be more dangerous than you think. But story must be conveyed for everyone.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
這比你想像的更危險，但這些故事一定要傳達給大家。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
You do not wonder why that journey should have stopped?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
你不好奇她的旅程為何中斷了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I want to make a song with these stories. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我想把這些故事寫成歌，請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
What made her disappear? Or for what? Please listen to her story.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
她為什麼會消失？又是為了什麼？請聽聽她的故事。

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
It will be more dangerous than you think. But the story must be conveyed.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
這比你想像的更危險，但這個故事必須傳達出去。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I wonder how far her heart has been reached? Please listen to her story. Please tell me.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
她的心究竟走了多遠？請聽聽她的故事，然後告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Please make a song for us.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
請替我們把這個故事寫成歌。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
She was the one who only cared for money. How far has her journey continued? Please listen to her story in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
她以前眼裡只有錢。她的旅程究竟走了多遠？去裡希塔樂鎮聽聽她的故事吧。

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
It will be more dangerous than you think. But the story must be conveyed.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
這比你想像的更危險，但這個故事必須傳達出去。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Please try to find him or a bow at Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
去裡希塔樂鎮找找他，或是他的弓。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Please do not forget to tell me any story you hear.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
聽到什麼故事，記得都告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I heard his shadow and his arrow are wandering somewhere. Please go to Lighthalzen and tell me his story.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
聽說他的影子和箭還在某處徘徊。去裡希塔樂鎮，告訴我他的故事吧。

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Please be careful of his arrows. You may have laid down on the cold floor before this story is finished.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
小心他的箭。在聽完這個故事之前，你可能就會倒在冰冷的地板上。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
What made stopped their journey? What kind of story is in it?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
是什麼讓他們的旅程停了下來？其中究竟藏著怎樣的故事？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Please check that story in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
去裡希塔樂鎮調查一下這段故事吧。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
But I guess... His journey also might have stopped somewhere in Lighthalzen. Please listen to his story.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
不過我猜......他的旅程也可能在裡希塔樂鎮某處中斷了。請聽聽他的故事。

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Please be careful not get lost like these ^FF0000poor souls^000000.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
小心些，別像這些^FF0000可憐的靈魂^000000一樣迷了路。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
According to that book, some magic by 25 years olds can be stronger than older wizards.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
書上說，25歲左右的魔法師施展的魔法，有時比年長巫師的還要強。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
What are you listening to seriously? Let's finish the request about Laurell Weinders story!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
你到底在聽什麼呀？先完成勞雷爾·溫德爾的故事委託吧！

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
But... These talented wizards could not return? Who made them? Find a clue in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
可是......這些有才能的巫師竟然沒能回來？是誰害的？去裡希塔樂鎮找找線索吧。

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I like this story but be careful if you do not want to end up a story yourself.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我很喜歡這個故事，不過你可得小心，別讓自己也成了故事裡的角色。

scripts.text: Angel Incarnation
scripts.translation: 天使型夢羅克分身

scripts.text: Black Nightmare Incarnation
scripts.translation: 黑色夢魘型夢羅克分身

scripts.text: Ghost Incarnation
scripts.translation: 幽靈型夢羅克分身

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
A monster from Morocc has wings like an angel. Maybe, Satan Morocc wants to be an angel?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
夢羅克分身長著天使般的翅膀。難道魔王夢羅克也想成為天使？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Appearance looks fine but inside.. I am sure they are flesh and blood!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
外表看起來不錯，可裡面......我敢說它們也是有血有肉的！

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
The shape is not completed but it has a very sharp tooth.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
它還沒完全成形，不過已經長出了鋒利的牙齒。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
This story should be spread out for weak adventurers like me! Because not everyone can be adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
應該把這個故事講給像我這樣弱小的冒險者聽！不是每個人都能成為冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
The creature without clothing has very weird shape. Haha do not take it seriously. I am just a story teller.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
那個沒穿衣服的生物長得真奇怪。哈哈，別當真，我只是個講故事的。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Well... This song is not about the prince of darkness, but it is taken from people who claim to have seen him.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
嗯......這首歌不是寫黑暗王子的，而是根據那些聲稱見過他的人所說的故事創作的。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I do not know if everything came out from Satan Morocc himself but things like this look horrible.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我不知道這些東西是不是都源自魔王夢羅克，不過它們看起來確實很可怕。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
This one is weird.. But he is also is an Incarnation of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
這個分身有點奇怪......不過它也是夢羅克的分身。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Story is not made yet, so I will ask next time !
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
故事還沒寫完，下次再來找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Wow. There are so many stories coming to me! Thanks to you!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
哇，腦海裡一下湧進這麼多故事！多虧了你！

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Haha please do not mind. It is just joke of a story teller. Please give me another story next time.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
哈哈，別在意，只是講故事的人開個玩笑。下次再告訴我別的故事吧。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Of course, I did not check by myself. But I am just a story teller as you see.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
當然，我也沒親自確認過。不過你看，我只是個講故事的嘛。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
But it is not safe.. So be careful! Please give me more stories! Maybe I can meet Satan Morocc somewhere around here?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
不過那裡不太安全......小心點！多給我講些故事吧！說不定我能在附近遇到魔王夢羅克呢？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Please help me to make a story by searching the flying Incarnations of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
請去尋找會飛的夢羅克分身，幫我編個故事吧。

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Be sure to get at least 30 Angel looking Incarnations of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
至少找到30只天使型夢羅克分身。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Do not you think that is going to be a very funny story?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
你不覺得這會是個很有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
But I think there also will be a story in it. That is why those creature are made. Please look for something black and tar-like.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
不過，我覺得這其中也藏著故事。那些生物一定是有原因才出現的。請去找些黑乎乎、像焦油一樣的東西。

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Find and get rid of 30 Dark Incarnation of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
找到並消滅30只黑色夢魘型夢羅克分身。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Maybe, adventurers have a good merit to know this kind of story. So can you please look for these creatures near Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
冒險者或許最適合瞭解這種故事。能去夢羅克附近找找這些生物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
But I am curious because it looks like a ghost and attacks does not work.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
不過我很好奇，它看起來像幽靈，而且攻擊對它不起作用。

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Please make a story after hunting at least 30 Ghost Incarnation of Morocc!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
請去狩獵至少30只幽靈型夢羅克分身，再把故事講給我聽！

scripts.text: Uni-Horn Scaraba Story
scripts.translation: 獨角甲蟲的故事

scripts.text: Horn Scaraba Story
scripts.translation: 雙角甲蟲的故事

scripts.text: Antler Scaraba Story
scripts.translation: 鹿角甲蟲的故事

scripts.text: Rake Horn Scaraba Story
scripts.translation: 尖角甲蟲的故事

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I am making a story about Uni-Horn Scaraba. One means less than two!~ I started but it is difficult to finish. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我在寫獨角甲蟲的故事。一隻角當然比兩隻角少嘛！我寫到一半就卡住了，你能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I am making a story... Two means less than three~ I started to make a story but I can not finish. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我正在寫故事......兩隻角當然比三隻角少~我寫到一半就寫不下去了，你願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
There seem to be more story about Antler Scaraba! Please help me if you have time.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
鹿角甲蟲似乎還有很多故事！有空的話請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I feel like Rake Horn Scaraba has more story. Please help me if you have time.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我覺得尖角甲蟲的故事也不少。有空的話請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
They also have some stories right? First, I wonder about the shape of the one with one horn.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
它們也各有各的故事吧？我最想知道那種只有一隻角的甲蟲是什麼樣的。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
That horn thing bothers me a little bit. What is the difference between one and two horns? Just appearance?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
那個角讓我有點在意。一隻角和兩隻角有什麼區別？只是外觀不同嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
There seemed to be more special Scarabas according to rumors. Stronger and more scary ones.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
聽說還有更特別的甲蟲，實力更強，也更可怕。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Here my plan is. I am making 4 passages for each Scaraba.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我的計劃是這樣的：每種甲蟲都寫四段故事。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
New world is full of amazing monsters. They will become a dream for children who want to be adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
新世界有許多奇妙的魔物，對想成為冒險者的孩子來說，它們就像夢想一樣。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
We talk about Horn Scaraba? There is one more we should mention.. That is Horn Scaraba!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我們說到雙角甲蟲了嗎？還有一種不能漏掉......就是雙角甲蟲！

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
This one is very unique! Horns look like the one of a deer so it is called an Antler Scaraba.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
這種甲蟲很特別！因為鹿角像鹿的角，所以叫鹿角甲蟲。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I'm starting to get confused. I am going to make a song of the Rake Horn Scarabas story.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我都快搞糊塗了。我想寫一首關於尖角甲蟲的歌。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I wonder what Uni-Horn Scarabas think? I want to make a song. Thanks for your help!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
獨角甲蟲在想些什麼呢？我想把它寫成歌。謝謝你幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
You came back safely! How is it? Horn Scaraba seemed to be a fun story. You really did a good job.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
你平安回來了！感覺怎麼樣？雙角甲蟲的故事似乎很有趣，你做得真好。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
It must be tiring traveling long distance! Please tell me if there are more interesting stories!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
長途旅行一定很累吧！要是還有有趣的故事，記得告訴我！

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Thank you ! I am sure that I can make a great song.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
謝謝你！我一定能寫出一首很棒的歌。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I want to make a song about the ^FF0000Uni-Horn Scaraba^000000!? Children will really like it.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我想寫一首關於^FF0000獨角甲蟲^000000的歌！孩子們一定會喜歡的。

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
You can find them near somewhere in the east at Scaraba Hall.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
在聖甲蟲大廳東側附近就能找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Maybe it is unnecessary. But curiosity is important for story tellers. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
也許沒什麼必要，但對講故事的人來說，好奇心很重要。哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I do no know why. I just heard from people. I need to make a song so please take a look at their world!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我也說不清為什麼，只是聽別人提起過。我得寫首歌，麻煩你去看看它們的世界吧！

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
You can find them near somewhere in the east at Scaraba Hall.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
在聖甲蟲大廳東側附近就能找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Do you think Antler Scaraba might be one of them?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
你覺得鹿角甲蟲也是其中一種嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Aren't you curious why it has that horn? I think it has an interesting story that people would like. Shall I ask you adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
你不好奇它為什麼長著那種角嗎？我覺得人們會喜歡它的故事。冒險者，你願意幫我問問嗎？

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Can you please find a story about Antler Scaraba? Experience yourself is the best I guess!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
能幫我找找鹿角甲蟲的故事嗎？親自去體驗一番最有收穫了。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Whoever listen or sing will be confused to sing a troll. It sounds fun, right?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
不管是聽歌還是唱歌，都會讓人忍不住跟著唱，想想就很有意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
A song begins with Uni-horn Scaraba then sing along with Rake Horn Scaraba. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
這首歌先從獨角甲蟲唱起，再接著唱尖角甲蟲的故事。你願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Take the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Please find a story about Rake Horn Scaraba from Scaraba Hall. Battle or experienced stories are fine.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
請去聖甲蟲大廳找找尖角甲蟲的故事。戰鬥經歷或親身見聞都可以。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Did you hear the story of Egnigem Cenia? Thanks you. I promise to make a good song.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
你聽說過暗●劍士的故事嗎？謝謝你，我保證會把它寫成一首好歌。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
The rest of the story of Egnigem Cenia is Okay, I will ask to someone else.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
關於暗●劍士的後續故事啊......好吧，我再去問問別人。

[Ragi]
Is Morocc's story good enough for songs? You did a good job.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I will ask to other adventurers about the story of the Angel-looking Incarnation of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我會再問問其他冒險者關於天使型夢羅克分身的故事。

scripts.translation: [拉吉]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I hope to see you again as we farewell with smile.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
那就笑著道別吧，希望我們還能再見。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Well, I am kind of busy doing an errand for Sir Aigu. Do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我正忙著替艾古大人跑腿。你有什麼想問的嗎？

scripts.text: Where did you get your hair-do?
scripts.translation: 你的髮型是在哪兒做的？

scripts.text: Please sing a song for me.
scripts.translation: 給我唱首歌吧

scripts.text: Do you have a girl friend?
scripts.translation: 你有女朋友嗎？

scripts.text: About Aigu
scripts.translation: 關於艾古

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
There is a fine hair artist in Alberta. He butchered my hair with a some cooking scissors. Looks illegal.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
艾爾貝塔有位很厲害的髮型師。他拿廚房剪刀把我的頭髮剪得一塌糊塗，簡直像違法了一樣。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I will never forget the first day I met her. She stared at me out of all the people in Izlude port. Now I help her by doing small errands.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我永遠忘不了第一次見到她的那天。在依斯魯得島港口的人群中，她偏偏注視著我。如今我替她跑些腿，幫點小忙。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I did not make a song as a member of band yet. Someday, I will make a great song for you!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我還沒以樂隊成員的身份創作過歌曲。總有一天，我會為你寫一首好歌！

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Sometimes, hair-dos or color are strange... but I was lucky I didn't die.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
有時髮型或髮色會變得很奇怪......不過我命大，至少沒丟掉性命。

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
Aigu is only on my mind. I can not think of anything else. I am fine even if it is just a one-sided love...
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我滿腦子都是艾古，什麼也想不了。就算只是單相思，我也甘之如飴......

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
But alas, I think Aigu likes someone else. ^FF0000We've never met... But I hate him.^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
唉，我覺得艾古喜歡上別人了。^FF0000我從沒見過那個人......可我已經討厭他了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
But I hate myself more because I want to stay around her even if she will never see me. Haha was I too serious?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
可我更討厭自己，明明她永遠不會注意到我，我卻還是想待在她身邊。哈哈，我是不是太認真了？

scripts.text:
[Ragi]
I am just a storyteller.. Any story can be made up. Most of the times it contains the truth.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我只是個講故事的人......故事可以是編出來的，但大多也藏著幾分真實。
